description:
Search OSHA violations found during workplace inspections.
Violation types: S=Serious, W=Willful, R=Repeat, O=Other, U=Unclassified, F=Failure to abate.
Returns standard cited, penalty amounts (initial and current), abatement status.
Link to inspections via activity_nr.

activity_nr.description: Inspection activity number (links to specific inspection)

standard.description: OSHA standard cited: '19100147' (control of hazardous energy)

viol_type.description: Violation type: S=Serious, W=Willful, R=Repeat, O=Other

name: dol_osha_violations
